title: Unbearable Longing (Miniature VIII for violin/viola duo)
program_note: This piece shares with ...as the waves at twilight... (Miniature IV for Violin) a certain introspective feeling, like dialogue with oneself.  It is also an exploration of a side of violin writing not usually explored, from slow sustained notes to extremely high harmonics.  It was composed in April, 1994, and later arranged for violin and viola duo.
